scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.build:netlify: npm install --prefix server --include=dev && npm run build --prefix server && npm run prisma:netlify --prefix server && npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build --prefix client
